evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story requests creating a game with name/description; unique functionality.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: No other story specifies invitation via URL as the primary mechanism.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round via a specific input field is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Moderator view of session items is distinct from similar participant stories (different actor).

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting (including re-estimating) is a general action; although PP-013 mentions re-estimation specifically, PP-005 already covers it so PP-005 remains the primary unique story.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding items during play is a distinct action not subsumed by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing items is different from adding/selecting/deleting; no duplicate found.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deleting items is distinct; no other story requests the same operation.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Moderator-controlled immediate reveal differs from other reveal/timing stories.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting the average as the agreed estimate is a distinct decision mechanism.

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-fill when unanimous is a specific behavior not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of agreed estimate is distinct from automation or averaging stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained by PP-005 which already covers selecting an item to be re-estimated (same actor, context, and goal).

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing via spreadsheet is a specific input method distinct from copy/paste (PP-015).

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is a different mechanism than import; thematic similarity alone doesn't make it duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing games list is distinct from viewing/exporting a game's transcript or scrolling within current game.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript (moderator) is distinct from exporting or participant scrolling functionality.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export to HTML is a distinct output format and action from viewing or exporting to CSV.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export is a distinct requirement from HTML export or viewing transcript.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game is distinct from deleting an account or items; no duplicate found.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation details are unique and not expressed in other stories.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login story is distinct from account creation, password reminder, and account management.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account modification is unique and not duplicated by other account stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is distinct from deleting games or other operations.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone presentation is a specific UI/UX requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder via email is distinct from other account stories.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0,1/2,...} or {0,1,2,...}
evaluations.rationale: Card set selection is a specific configurable option, not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Numeric limit on invitations is a distinct constraint not expressed elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining via URL and entering name is distinct from invitation mechanism story (PP-002).

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Estimator's view of the current item is unique and not duplicated by moderator actions.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Estimator's ability to see session items is distinct from moderator's similar story because actor differs.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Presence indicator for who has submitted is distinct from seeing mapping of who gave which estimate after reveal.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic simultaneous reveal after all votes is a specific behavior distinct from moderator-forced reveal.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: This story explicitly defines condition for changing estimate; unique as phrased.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained by PP-039 which allows scrolling back through stories and estimates from prior rounds (same actor and goal).

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Seeing mapping of who gave which estimate during the round is distinct from presence indicators and historical scrolling.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer start capability is unique and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic timer reset behavior is a specific timing detail separate from timer start.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Allows historical navigation through prior rounds; covers broader functionality (hence used as related for PP-035).

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering persistence is a specific UI requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Semantically equivalent to PP-034 (same actor, condition and goal); PP-041 is redundant/subsumed by PP-034.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Personal thumbnail display is a unique UI feature not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is a developer-level non-functional requirement distinct from others.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary/definitions is a unique documentation requirement not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexing is a specific developer task not expressed elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Specific cross-browser compatibility targets are unique non-functional requirements.

evaluations.evidence: have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a distinct requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance/responsiveness is a unique non-functional requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a specific technical requirement not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design requirement is distinct from other usability requirements.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page quality is a unique UX requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Data anonymization for research is a distinct requirement with a different actor/purpose than analytics stories.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics/usage dashboard for Mike is a distinct stakeholder need not duplicated elsewhere.
